text:
Hi there, and thank you for contacting Leafy! Congratulations on your new calathea. I know it can be worrying when leaves start to yellow, so let me put your mind at ease.

**Yellowing of one or two older leaves in the first two weeks is normal transplant stress.** Your plant is adjusting to its new home, and on its own that isn't covered by our Plant Care Guarantee, so a replacement wouldn't be approved for this alone.

**When a replacement is possible:** Every live plant has a 30-day guarantee from delivery (90 days for Leafy Plus members). If the plant declines significantly despite reasonable care, we send one free replacement. Significant decline means:
- Losing more than a third of its leaves
- Stem or root rot
- Collapse

**What I'd suggest for now:**
- Keep it out of direct sun for the first week, which you've likely done already.
- Don't repot for 2-3 weeks.
- Water only when the top inch of soil is dry. Overwatering is the most common cause of early problems.

**If it gets worse:** Make a claim from "My Orders" within your guarantee window, with at least two photos (the whole plant and a close-up). A Plant Care Specialist will review it within 2 business days, and you don't need to send the plant back.

Plant Care Specialists also offer free care advice by chat (9am-5pm Mon-Fri, your local time) or email at help@leafy.example, which is answered within 1 business day. They can help if you'd like a second pair of eyes on your calathea.

Is there anything else I can help with? Please reach out any time, and I hope your calathea perks up soon! 🌿
